heroTitle: Most platforms function as static systems of record.
heroParagraphs: They capture payments, work orders, lease details but rarely bridge the gap between raw data and strategic outcomes. They show you where you've been but fail to forecast the impact of decisions on your P&L, employee experience or enterprise risk.

C&D turns your data into a decision engine. By combining deep domain expertise with data architecture specific to corporate real estate, we provide the "connective tissue" between your daily operations and your board-room goals. We don't just organize your data; we optimize it to unlock capital, slash operational costs, improve employee experience and future-proof your portfolio against risk.

cta.title: Navigate the Future of Your Portfolio
cta.body: Most portfolios are sitting on a goldmine of data trapped within static systems. Our Portfolio Data Audit is a high-impact diagnostic identifying the bottlenecks that are preventing your teams from moving at the speed of the market.
bullets: AI Readiness: A clear assessment of how prepared your architecture is for the next wave of automation.
The Integrity Gap: Pinpoint exactly which data sources are undermining your high-stakes decisions.
The CDM Shortcut: Discover how our Common Data Model unblocks your IT teams and accelerates analytics cycles by 10x.
The ROI Roadmap: A prioritized list of optimization tasks that lead to immediate cost reduction and time savings.
